description: React component module implementing form UI components using react-hook-form and radix UI primitives, including context management for form fields, labels, controls, descriptions, and messages.

methods.name: useFormField
methods.description: Custom hook to access form field state and context, providing IDs and validation error info.

methods.name: FormItem
methods.description: Component that provides a unique ID for form items and wraps children.

methods.name: FormLabel
methods.description: Component rendering a label for a form field, indicating error state.

methods.name: FormControl
methods.description: Component rendering a form control slot with accessibility attributes.

methods.name: FormDescription
methods.description: Component rendering descriptive text for a form field.

methods.name: FormMessage
methods.description: Component rendering validation error messages for a form field.
